newsitem.title: USA: Monsanto tenders for rest of Calgene.
newsitem.headline: Monsanto tenders for rest of Calgene.

text.p: Monsanto Co said its wholly owned Monsanto Acquisition Co Inc on Monday began its $8 per share tender for all of the shares of Calgene Inc that Monsanto does not already own.
On March 31, Monsanto said it entered into a definitive merger agreement with Calgene, a California-based biotechnology firm, in a transaction valued at $240 million.

Under the agreement, following completion of the tender, Monsanto will acquire any remaining Calgene shares in a second-step merger at the same cash price of $8 per share. Monsanto now has about 54.5 percent of Calgene's shares.
The offer is conditioned on a majority of the outstanding shares not now owned by Monsanto being tendered by Calgene's shareholders.

It also is conditioned on Monsanto owning not less than 90 percent of the outstanding shares at the completion of the tender offer. Monsanto has agreed to waive this condition 20 business days after the initial expiration date of the tender if all other conditions have been satisfied.
The tender offer expires at midnight on May 2.
